characters.name_or_role: Man in black overcoat (deadpan husband/partner figure)
personality_traits: Deadpan and sarcastic - delivers the punchline 'Oh, you thought this was the kissing part?' with a flat, matter-of-fact tone while a tsunami looms behind him
Unbothered by catastrophe - stands still and gestures casually with open palms while the crowd behind him sprints past in terror
Mildly condescending/superior toward his companion, as if she should already know how their relationship works
Jaded/world-weary, implying this apocalyptic banter is a recurring routine for the couple, not their first brush with disaster
emotional_range: Calm indifference (arms/hands relaxed, conversational gesturing) at 0:03-0:06 despite the giant wave and screaming extras in frame
Wry, knowing sarcasm while delivering the 'kissing part' line around 0:07-0:08
Heavy-lidded, half-closed 'low battery' eyes of resignation as the line lands (0:09-0:10), eyelids drooping mid-conversation as if his energy is running out
Brief flash of sharp irritation - narrowed eyes, drawn-down eyebrows, bared teeth in a scowl - in the closing beat, as if annoyed she even had to ask
expressions: Neutral, slightly bored gaze while facing the woman with the wave rising behind them (periodic-2/3)
Mouth opens mid-sentence, eyebrows raised in mock-surprise as he asks the 'kissing part' question (periodic-8, synced to on-screen word 'KISSING')
Eyes droop to half-lidded, sardonic slits as the subtitle 'PART?' appears (periodic-9)
Eyes remain heavy and unimpressed through 'KNOW' (periodic-11)
Final beat: eyebrows sharply angled down, eyes narrowed to points, mouth open baring teeth in an irritated snarl (periodic-12), a much more intense expression than anything preceding it
gestures: Stands with hands loosely clasped at waist, weight settled back on his heels - a relaxed, non-fleeing posture that contrasts with the panicking crowd
Opens one hand outward toward the woman in a small explanatory/conversational gesture as he speaks (periodic-3 to periodic-7)
Leans his head and long nose slightly toward her for emphasis on the punchline
Body stays planted and squared to her the entire scene - never turns to look at the oncoming wave
characters.interactions_notes: He faces the woman directly in a tight, face-to-face two-shot, maintaining unbroken eye contact with her rather than the disaster behind them. He initiates and drives the exchange (the questioning, sarcastic line), positioning him as the one 'in the know' and slightly dominant in the banter, while she reacts. Physically they stand almost nose-to-nose, isolated as a calm island amid the fleeing crowd, which visually sets them apart as a bonded pair unfazed by the apocalypse.

characters.name_or_role: Woman in brown turtleneck (deadpan wife/partner figure)
personality_traits: Expectant/naive in the moment - her stance and slightly parted lips suggest she genuinely anticipated a romantic 'movie disaster' beat (a kiss) before the wave hits
Quick to match her partner's deadpan energy rather than showing fear, despite the tsunami closing in
Composed and self-possessed - hands stay near her own torso rather than grabbing him or fleeing
Dryly resigned by the end, absorbing his jab without protest
emotional_range: Mild curiosity/anticipation as she looks up at him near the start of the exchange (periodic-2/3)
Slight surprise/defensiveness as his sarcastic question lands (periodic-8/9), mouth opening as if to respond
Eyes go heavy-lidded and half-closed in unison with his 'low battery' look, eyebrows knitting slightly (periodic-10/11)
By the final frame her expression settles into weary, eyes-averted resignation, eyebrows raised slightly as if accepting the tease (periodic-12)
expressions: Attentive, wide-eyed look directed up at him as the wave looms behind (periodic-2/3)
Mouth opens as if about to speak/react right as his 'kissing part' line lands (periodic-8)
Eyelids droop to the same half-closed 'low battery' state as his (periodic-9 through 11), a mirrored visual gag between the pair
Final beat: eyes softened and slightly turned away from him, a small resigned almost-smile at the corner of the mouth (periodic-12)
gestures: Hands held close to her body near the waist/chest, fingers loosely curled - a composed, non-panicked posture
Head tilts up toward him throughout, maintaining the conversational eye line despite the height difference from his tall neck and nose
No stepping or fleeing motion at all during the entire exchange, reinforcing her calm parallel to his stillness
Slight recoil/lean-back of the head at the punchline moment, a small reactive flinch rather than a big gesture
characters.interactions_notes: She stays locked in a face-to-face stance with him, mirroring his stillness and eventually his drooping 'low battery' eyes, which visually cements them as a matched pair rather than a leader/follower dynamic. She listens and reacts rather than initiating dialogue in this segment; the power dynamic tilts slightly toward him since he delivers the punchline and she absorbs it, but her calm unhurried physicality signals she is his equal in temperament, not intimidated by him. Neither character ever looks at the wave or the fleeing crowd behind them - their sustained eye contact with each other, ignoring mortal danger, is the core visual joke of the scene.
